description: Searches Lokuli for local service businesses near a US zip code or city. Most businesses on Lokuli are in California, a few in other states. Understands everyday and Spanish wording ("deep clean", "fade", "mani pedi", "limpieza de casa"). Returns businesses that can be booked through Lokuli, with their services, prices and service ids, each marked with how it matched (name, service, synonym, or trade, meaning the same kind of business), and, separately, businesses from public records that are not on Lokuli and can't be booked.

service.description: What the person needs, in plain words: "haircut", "dog grooming", "brake repair"
